answer: Unique resource challenge ledger: each new identity must submit a fresh hardware attestation signal checked against a shared duplicate ledger before transacting. Accepted identities prepay a nonrefundable compute fee and draw a scarce nectar allowance from a per-endpoint quota. A public comet beacon samples identities for replay audits; duplicate or failed audit forfeits the fee and bans the trace, so each additional copy costs more than its expected payout.
